title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF advanced efforts to enhance the response to violence against children (VAC) by strengthening the social service workforce (SSW) and supporting the implementation of Law 13.431/2017 on protective hearing for child victims of violence.;; Within the National Pact on Law 13431/2017, led by the Ministry of Justice and Public Security, UNICEF helped update the national referral pathway, providing clear guidance for states and municipalities to establish local mechanisms prescribed by the law. Through the Seal Strategy, UNICEF trained 13,469 professionals on implementing the law, indirectly benefiting over 67,000 children and adolescents. Technical assistance to municipalities in the Amazon and Semi-Arid regions led to the creation of 1,234 collegiate committees for the law’s implementation, while 1,276 municipalities adopted the SIPIA case management system to register and refer VAC cases. Additionally, 2,023 schools reported implementing violence prevention practices,
